topics.name: Known Deviation and Accepted Risk
topics.purpose: Define explicit bounded release deviations/known failures with exact scope, rationale, owner, expiry/review and compensating controls.

semantics.identity_rule: Each deviation has an explicit identity.
semantics.finding_rule: Exact failed/missing test/control/finding refs are explicit.
semantics.approval_rule: Acceptance requires exact authorized reviewer/owner evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Deviation cannot waive unrelated safety gates implicitly.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: known failure hidden in release notes only

references.purpose: Acceptance profile may allow explicitly reviewed deviations.
